vb_textbox.text: it was a bit tricky to find a concrete pattern, however there were some things i noticed. the brown gnome did tend to get more mushrooms than the others, but not all of the time. in my experience you have to take note of which gnomes are getting the most mushrooms and then switch to the other when you notice that the gnome drops below 5 mushrooms. e.g. if the brown gnome is giving 8 or 9 mushrooms, stick with it until it drops below 5, then switch to the red gnome. i found that when the brown gnome was giving lots of mushrooms, the green one was too. and when the red gnome was giving lots of mushrooms, the purple one was too. best to play them in those pairs.
